amazonFailed.title: Amazon shipments didn’t load
amazonFailed.description: Refresh the page to try again.

none.title: No shipments yet
none.buyerDescription: Start one from a sent purchase order.

changesWaiting.title: Changes waiting for approval
changesWaiting.buyer: Packing opens once you answer the proposed changes on the purchase order.
changesWaiting.supplier: Packing opens once the customer answers the proposed changes on the order.

labels.title: Shipping labels
labels.fba: Book transport to Amazon, then upload the shipping labels.
labels.agl: Book AGL transport in Amazon, then upload the shipping labels.

approve.updateCostDescription: Shopify costs must be in the purchase order’s currency.

reconcile.awdInvalid: Enter the Amazon order ID, which starts with STAR-
reconcile.fbaInvalid: Enter the inbound plan ID, which starts with wf

forward.title: Mark shipped
forward.description: The freight cost is added to the purchase order’s landed costs.
forward.enterReference: Enter the tracking or booking number

amazonAuthorization.sellerId: Enter the seller’s merchant token, such as A2CIYIV0E1FHU3
amazonAuthorization.refreshToken: Paste the full refresh token, which starts with Atzr|

prep.polybag: Seal each unit in a clear polybag.
prep.blackShrinkWrap: Shrink-wrap each unit in black film.
prep.hanger: Put each garment on a hanger.
prep.label: Label each unit.

requirements.fbaCartons: FBA cartons: mixed SKUs are allowed; at most 63.5 cm (25 in) on each side and 22.68 kg (50 lb), unless one unit is larger.
requirements.awdUsCartons: AWD US cartons: one SKU per carton, at most 150 units, every carton of a SKU packed the same way; at most 63.5 cm (25 in) on each side and 22.68 kg (50 lb).
requirements.unitLabels: Label every unit with its FNSKU barcode, covering any other barcode.
requirements.suffocationWarnings: Polybags need a suffocation warning when the opening is 5 in (12.7 cm) or wider.
requirements.multiPacks: Keep each multi-pack together, with one label on the pack.
requirements.bundle: {count, plural, one {Bundle # unit into one pack.} other {Bundle # units into one pack.}}
requirements.suffocationLabel: Put a suffocation warning label on each polybag.
